title: Phủ Cam Cathedral

buildingCutout.basis: The historical 60 m envelope follows the published length, approximate old site and southbound nave axis.

terrainReference.basis: Original Copernicus GLO-30 at the approximate former entrance. The front stair lowers toward the north approach, and footings extend to the approximate slope.

mapIdentity.provider: Historic parish dimensions and the mapped Phước Quả hill approach

identities.name: Phủ Cam Cathedral
identities.address: Historic Catholic cathedral site at Phước Quả hill, Huế, Vietnam

mapIdentity.scope: The parish history gives the nominal length, width, north entrance and twin towers. Modern mapped approach and the hilltop tie locate the historical envelope approximately at the same site.

note: The Dieulefils postcard shows symmetrical bell towers with low domes, stepped moldings and pinnacles, the entrance arcade, a gabled center with an oculus and the wide approach stair. Published church history describes 25 m towers.
